input.plan:
# Fix the preferences popup and credits banner

## What is actually happening

Two separate surfaces are fighting the board.

**1. The modal is not a settings page. It is forced onboarding.**

After Google login, [`ensure_default_preferences`](relocation_jobs/opportunities/service.py) writes `germany` with `preferences_confirmed=False`. The board already loads Germany companies. Then [`init`](relocation_jobs/static/js/main.js) calls [`maybeShowPreferencesOnboarding`](relocation_jobs/static/js/preferences.js), which does `dialog.showModal()` whenever that flag is still false.

That flag only flips to true on **Save**. Cancel / Escape / closing the tab leaves it false, so the next visit pops again. The screenshot still shows Cancel + the title "Search preferences" — that is the non-required variant from the banner **Preferences** button (always rendered). Same dialog, two entry points, both overlay the jobs.

Country picking already lives in the account menu (`#preferencesLink`). Putting it in a blocking dialog *and* on a billing strip is the interrupt.

**2. The blue bar is a dump of internal capacity meta, not a status UI.**

[`renderBoardScopeBanner`](relocation_jobs/static/js/board-scope.js) concatenates every field from board meta:

- plan name
- `10/10 company slots`
- `up to 3 roles each`
- `30 credits left (30 free + 0 paid)`
- upgrade pitch
- three actions: Preferences, Add credits, See plans

In the screenshot the only real constraint is **company slots are full**. Credits are unused (30). Preferences do not belong on a billing strip. The promotional/purchased split already exists in the Credits dialog and in the account menu (`Credits · 30` in [`showApp`](relocation_jobs/static/js/auth.js)).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  load[Board load] --> defaults["Write Germany, confirmed=false"]
  defaults --> paint[Paint jobs]
  paint --> modal["showModal Search preferences"]
  paint --> banner["Always-on kitchen-sink strip"]
  banner --> prefsBtn[Preferences button]
  prefsBtn --> modal
```

## Recommended UX

- **Never auto-open the preferences dialog.** Defaults stay Germany; the board is usable immediately.
- **Preferences stays a dialog**, but only from the account menu. Strip the billing sentence ("Free accounts include a company cap").
- **If `needs_preferences`:** one quiet line on the strip — `Matching Germany. Change countries from your account menu.` — no extra Preferences button, not a modal.
- **Banner becomes state-based, one message + one CTA:**

| State | Copy | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Company slots full | Company board is full | See plans |
| Credits = 0 | Next new matched role needs credits | Add credits |
| Unconfirmed countries | Matching Germany. Change countries from your account menu. | none (account menu) |
| Otherwise | Hide the strip | — |

Do not show promotional vs purchased, "up to 3 roles each", or "Full Access removes…" on the idle board. Peek caps stay on truncated company cards if they already exist. Wallet detail stays in the Credits dialog.

## Files

- [`relocation_jobs/static/js/preferences.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/preferences.js) — `maybeShowPreferencesOnboarding` becomes a no-op (or delete the call). Optional-dialog copy: countries only.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/js/main.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/main.js) — drop the post-load onboarding call.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/js/board-scope.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/board-scope.js) — replace the `parts.join(" ")` dump with the state table above. Remove the Preferences button. Show Add credits / See plans only in the matching row.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/styles.css`](relocation_jobs/static/styles.css) — keep `.board-scope-banner`; no new chrome. Idle = `hidden`.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/index.html`](relocation_jobs/static/index.html) — bump `main.js?v=` cache query.

No backend change required for the interrupt. `preferences_confirmed` / `needs_preferences` stay as-is; we just stop treating them as "block the UI".

## Tests

No existing JS tests for the banner. After the change, run `pytest tests/web/test_personalized_board.py tests/test_entitlements.py -o addopts=` to confirm meta still ships `needs_preferences`, caps, and credits — the API contract does not change.

## Verify

Local panel on 5051: load a free account that has never saved preferences — board paints with **no modal**. Hit 10/10 slots — strip says only that + See plans. Zero credits — strip says only that + Add credits. Open Preferences from the account menu — country list, no billing copy, Cancel works.

Rewrite renderBoardScopeBanner into mutually exclusive states (slots full / zero credits / unconfirmed / hidden)
Bump static cache query and verify the three banner states plus no auto-modal on local panel

content.text:
It was on the left because of a CSS reset, not because anyone designed it that way.

The panel has `* { margin: 0 }`. Native `<dialog>` centers with `margin: auto`. That reset wipes the auto margin, so Safari (and anything that follows the spec strictly) parks the modal at the top-left of the viewport. Chrome often still fakes centering; Safari does not.

That is now restored: `.preferences-dialog` uses `position: fixed; inset: 0; margin: auto; height: fit-content`. On the local panel the box is dead-center (viewport 692×823, dialog center 346×412). Cache bust is `styles.css?v=92`.

The kuchup.com screenshot is still the **old production bundle** — kitchen-sink banner, billing copy in the hint, left-pinned dialog. Local already has the plan: no auto-open, country-only hint, state-based strip, and a centered modal. Those show up on kuchup.com after deploy.
